posts.subject: Map bugs and abusing maps
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello I'm writing this and complaining like a lil bitch right now cause I love doing that but I'm going to post some maps that have bugs that can affect other players in a bad or good way and some maps that maybe have to be fixed. I'm also going to post some new maps that maybe can be added, but here are the maps that have annyoing bugs:


35hp_dreampark Only 2 players can join, 1 in CT one in T, rest are stuck in spec for a while and then get kicked out
35hp_Iraq_v2 This map has a chance to still break/shutdown the server, the server will "reboot" and you can join again on a diffrent map
35hp_oasis Still keep the nades to easy to spawn camp
35_tropicana This one thank you @Luckiris and @CrazE and @Flash
35_galaxy_v4 If you have the no fall damage as the stamm rank "rubin" and you fall of the map, you don't die
35_thenucleus Same problem as "galaxy_v4"
35hp_lego_boxing If you "trade" your knife with someone on your team they can pick it up fast and throw it to the enemy site or in the little boxing arena
35hp_villa Still keep the nades to easy to spawn camp
35hp_minecraft_hell Still keep the nades to easy to spawn camp


These maps can you abuse stuff or just plain annoying and this is opinion is by me and multibale players:


35hp_forest Players with shit pc get extremly low fps on this map, or just bad pc overall
35hp_shipfight Alot of players like to delay on the mast, it kinda annyoing tbh, like yeah I can tell to not to and stuff but that is the camping spot of gold for them cause there is also a nade there (you can keep nade on this one aswell)
35hp_trampoline In my opinion and alot of other players think this map should be removed
35hp_lego_warning_v2 kinda small, just if there is like a full server or just about to be, can be edit or fixed in someone like replaced with some bigger version
ka_dreamy_jumps_v2 Same with "trampoline" just plain annyoing map


[Extra stuff]


35_ocean In the nominate tab and admin tab there are two 35_ocean to choose from, I think it's the same map it's just a small map
Alot of map I did not mention you can still keep the nade/molotov so that should be taken care of aswell, I just mention the maps I know of
35hp_color works fine but it can be updated to a new much nice looking map that is called "35hp_colourful"


These are maps I played or I think look good enough to be added/replaced:


35hp_forbiddenforest
35hp_spartans_go
35hp_3_2013
35hp_fepsi_beta
35hp_fepsi_v3


That's it for me, hopefully that it will be a change. [danke*]

I totally agree with @WHAT on everything.


I would like to add that we should remove the different version of the same map. ( For example 35hp_$2000$ has too much versions on the server )


Thanks for reading this.

All you do is complaint all the time you fukin pleb 😏



@WHAT anyway I agree with you here 100%

Well, that was fun, wasting 4+ hours and staying up until 4am, thanks @WHAT 🙂
Decompiling the maps, extracting the textures and then editing the maps is quite tedious but weirdly rewarding at the same time.


This is what I've done so far (complete changelog will be posted in a seperate public thread):

Blame that on m8y. [dumm**] He does not have any floors on his map. Seriously. He used player clips under his displacements, since you can't walk through them. But because there is only player clips and no floors, the map won't compile. I've tried to fix that by changing as many player clips as I can but I kept missing some and I gave up, since I've never seen anything that dumb and I didn't want to deal with his mistakes.
